examined_formations.title: CHINA_WUXI_8_FTE_INDIRECT_CONTROL_COMPLETED_BEFORE_PERIOD_WITH_CURRENT_REVENUE_BUT_NET_LOSS_NEGATIVE_OCF_AND_PHYSICAL_AUTO_COMPONENT_FLOW
observed_actor_state_change_evidence: Gu Jiayu acquired 100% of Shengdi Banglun for RMB840,000 under a 2024-09-03 equity-transfer agreement.
Business-registration change completed on 2024-10-18; Gu Jiayu thereby indirectly held 14,579,392 shares, 54.42% of Jintian Yuanfeng, and became actual controller.
The completed control change predates the full 2026 H1 reporting period.
objective_endowment_or_underuse_evidence: The 2026 H1 report directly discloses only 8 employees, down from 10 at period start.
Current total assets are about RMB3.0397m, but liabilities are about RMB3.3622m and equity is negative.
Current business centers on intelligent vehicle-control-system components, supply-chain coordination, logistics-enterprise customers and technical support.
observed_behavior_or_workaround_evidence: 2026 H1 revenue is RMB765,709.75, up sharply from a very small prior-period base.
2026 H1 attributable net profit is negative RMB604,400.80.
2026 H1 operating cashflow is explicitly negative RMB2,546,914.06, driven by procurement prepayments, slower receivable collection and earlier payable settlement.
contradiction_or_partial_flow_evidence: This packet proves that completed pre-period control, a current report and 8 FTE can coexist, but current positive profit and positive OCF still fail simultaneously.
Low headcount does not turn a component procurement/sales/technical-support flow into standardized machine-only recurring revenue.
Negative equity and cash consumption independently block normalized founder-light economics.
economic_signal: Upstream holding-company acquisition consideration RMB840,000; indirect target control 54.42%.
2026 H1 revenue RMB765,709.75; attributable net loss RMB604,400.80.
2026 H1 OCF negative RMB2,546,914.06; current total assets RMB3.0397m; current FTE 8.
exact_incumbent_and_control_surface_pref: The control position is an actual operating company with a small team, not merely a pending transfer.
Current value delivery depends on physical vehicle-control components, supplier coordination and customer technical support.
Because net profit and OCF fail the early gate, no deeper claim about a scarce recurring software/data control surface is promoted.

examined_formations.title: CHINA_BEIJING_8_FTE_SOFTWARE_HARDWARE_INTEGRATOR_WITH_81_26_PERCENT_PROPOSED_CONTROL_TERMINATED_UNPAID_AND_CURRENT_NEGATIVE_PROFIT_OCF
observed_actor_state_change_evidence: Wang Qinglei and Li Hongwei signed a 2025-10-23 agreement for 17,756,000 shares, 81.26% of Longjoy Technology.
The acquisition was terminated by agreement on 2026-06-09.
The company disclosed that the acquirer had not paid the acquisition consideration and that Li Hongwei remained controlling shareholder and actual controller.
objective_endowment_or_underuse_evidence: Current company profile and annual staffing disclosure report only 8 employees.
The 2026 H1 report describes multimedia equipment, education information products, digital-media systems integration and technical services.
Current total assets are about RMB2.4993m.
observed_behavior_or_workaround_evidence: 2026 H1 attributable net profit is negative RMB71,596.35.
2026 H1 operating cashflow is negative RMB96,495.30.
contradiction_or_partial_flow_evidence: A signed acquisition report is not an executed control transfer; the unpaid transaction was explicitly terminated.
Current 8 FTE and a small asset base cannot be rebound to a hypothetical fresh controller who never acquired the company.
Current economics are also loss-making and cashflow-negative, so the formation fails independently even before system-integration delivery is normalized.
economic_signal: Proposed 81.26% share transfer was terminated before completion and remained unpaid.
2026 H1 revenue RMB351,299.25; attributable net loss RMB71,596.35; OCF negative RMB96,495.30.
Current assets about RMB2.4993m; current employee count 8.
exact_incumbent_and_control_surface_pref: The early execution gate prevents acquisition-report paperwork from being mistaken for an acquired operating position.
Existing delivery includes equipment, software/hardware integration, installation, commissioning, training and technical services.
No fresh-operator control surface exists to evaluate because the proposed buyer never completed the acquisition.

examined_formations.title: CHINA_CHONGQING_15_FTE_MEDIA_CONTROL_COMPLETED_INSIDE_H1_WITH_CURRENT_NET_LOSS_AND_FIELD_PROMOTION_PROJECT_REVENUE
observed_actor_state_change_evidence: Yudu Media's 2026 H1 report states that Zhongtai Jiye Asset Management completed the acquisition on 2026-02-09 and Pan Qiao became actual controller.
The acquisition structure combines direct/indirect ownership and voting-right delegation; after completion the acquirer held 31.09% economically and controlled 94.01% of voting rights.
Because completion occurred inside the 2026-01-01 to 2026-06-30 reporting period, the H1 statement is not a clean full-period post-control ledger.
objective_endowment_or_underuse_evidence: Current H1 employees increased from 6 to 15.
Revenue composition shows RMB943,396.23 of field-promotion project revenue and RMB110,062.88 of advertising-service revenue.
observed_behavior_or_workaround_evidence: 2026 H1 attributable net profit is negative RMB433,179.59.
The report therefore fails the positive-net-profit early gate without requiring selective OCF interpretation.
The dominant current revenue stream is an on-the-ground promotion project rather than an evidenced standardized recurring digital rail.
contradiction_or_partial_flow_evidence: A completed control transaction does not create a clean post-control evidence window when the control event occurs inside the reporting period.
Fifteen employees are still relatively small, but the current operating flow is field/project heavy and loss-making.
Deep OCF reconciliation would not change the rejection because control-period purity and positive net profit already fail.
economic_signal: Control completed 2026-02-09 inside 2026 H1; acquirer controls 94.01% voting rights while holding 31.09% economically.
2026 H1 revenue RMB1,053,459.11; attributable net loss RMB433,179.59.
Current employee count 15; field-promotion projects contribute RMB943,396.23 of current revenue.
exact_incumbent_and_control_surface_pref: The time-window gate is evaluated before treating H1 figures as post-control continuity.
Current value delivery is dominated by field promotion/advertising project execution rather than a machine-only repeatable right.
Because clean period and profit fail, no deeper scarcity or incumbent-control-surface claim is promoted.

excluded_observations: Scan 060-118 formations and their primary discovery signals were excluded from Scan 119 primary formation selection.
Jiexian Technology was not deepened because disclosed staffing remained far above the intrinsically-low-FTE floor and the operating shape remained hardware/manufacturing/cloud-solution delivery.
New Changyue was not deepened because current operations had stopped with zero revenue and negative economics while a new proposed transaction occurred only after the current reporting period.
Pending, terminated or in-period control events were not relabeled as clean completed pre-period control merely because a signed acquisition document existed.
No job, gig, RFQ, procurement or asset-marketplace feed was used as the discovery ontology.
